name: qlrisk_ccr_exposure
title: Counterparty exposure
description: Counterparty credit exposure. mode='trade_profiles' simulates each trade's exposure profile from the market data: EE, PFE, effective EE (EEE), EPE, effective EPE, peak PFE and a CVA where qlrisk's product model gives one (a warning says when it does not). mode='calculator' runs a qlrisk exposure calculator from summary inputs: measure ce (current exposure, collateral-adjusted), ee, eee, pfe, peak, stressed (crisis scenarios). mode='wrong_way' measures wrong-way risk: exposure conditional on the counterparty's credit spread widening by shock_sigmas. Calculator fields: ce: mark_to_market (number, required); collateral_held (number, default 0.0); collateral_posted (number, default 0.0); collateral_haircut (number, default 0.0); threshold (number, default 0.0); minimum_transfer_amount (number, default 0.0); independent_amount (number, default 0.0); netting_set_id (['string', 'null']); trades_in_netting_set (array). ee: current_mtm (number, required); notional (number, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, required); product_type (string, default irs); interest_rate (number, default 0.05); drift (number, default 0.0); collateral_held (number, default 0.0); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 0.03968253968253968); num_simulations (integer, default 10000); time_grid (array); exposure_paths (array). eee: current_mtm (number, required); notional (number, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, required); product_type (string, default irs); interest_rate (number, default 0.05); drift (number, default 0.0); collateral_held (number, default 0.0); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 0.03968253968253968); num_simulations (integer, default 10000); time_grid (array); exposure_paths (array). pfe: current_mtm (number, required); notional (number, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, required); product_type (string, default irs); interest_rate (number, default 0.05); fx_rate (number, default 1.0); credit_spread (number, default 0.01); collateral_held (number, default 0.0); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 0.03968253968253968); num_simulations (integer, default 10000); time_grid (array); exposure_paths (array). peak: current_mtm (number, required); notional (number, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, required); product_type (string, default irs); ee_profile (array); pfe_profile (array); time_grid (array); num_simulations (integer, default 10000); confidence_level (number, default 0.95); collateral_held (number, default 0.0). stressed: current_mtm (number, required); notional (number, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, required); product_type (string, default irs); stress_type (string, default historical); stress_scenario (['string', 'null']); rate_shock (number, default 0.0); fx_shock (number, default 0.0); credit_shock (number, default 0.0); volatility_shock (number, default 0.0); correlation_shock (number, default 0.0); historical_returns (array); lookback_period (integer, default 250). Config: ce: apply_netting, apply_collateral, include_threshold; ee: method (monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, calculate_effective; eee: method (monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, calculate_effective; pfe: method (add_on|monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, time_horizon; peak: method (ee_based|pfe_based), num_simulations; stressed: stress_type, default_scenario. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode, measure, inputs; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, config, time_horizon, num_scenarios, credit_factor, shock_sigmas, horizon_days, lookback, top_n, confidence_pct) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "mode": "trade_profiles"} gives Exposure profiles for 1 trade(s); largest peak PFE 623,804.12 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
